name.es-ES: Constituciones de la Compañía de Jesús
name.en-US: Constitutions of the Society of Jesus

description.es-ES: Las Constituciones de la Compañía de Jesús (1544–1556): el Examen general, el Proemio y las diez Partes, con las Declaraciones, en la numeración tradicional [1]–[827]. Texto español de Ignacio, con la ortografía del siglo XVI.
description.en-US: The Constitutions of the Society of Jesus (1544–1556): the General Examen, the Proemium and the ten Parts, with the Declarations, in the traditional numbering [1]–[827]. Ignatius's Spanish text, in sixteenth-century spelling.
description.pt-BR: As Constituições da Companhia de Jesus (1544–1556): o Exame geral, o Proêmio e as dez Partes, com as Declarações, na numeração tradicional [1]–[827].

es-ES.editor: Texto español de las Constituciones, via Documenta Catholica Omnia

sources.edition: Constituciones de la Compañía de Jesús (Examen general, Proemio, Partes 1-10 with the Declarations), Documenta Catholica Omnia PDF, paragraphs [1]-[827]. The Declarations keep their letters (A, B...) and the letter references [A] in the text. Taken from the PDF by font size: the modern apparatus of the edition (footnotes noting later derogations and the cross-references to the Normas Complementarias) is left out.
sources.description: Ignatius's Spanish text (Texto autógrafo/Spanish text a and A, approved 1558) with the traditional paragraph numbers. Chapter headings follow the PDF; the Examen's chapter 6 heading was put back in order.
sources.tierEvidence: Ignatius died in 1556 and the Constitutions were approved in 1558; the text is Ignatius's own Spanish, distributed by Documenta Catholica Omnia without any copyright claim or licence; free in practice.
